question: Which specific treasures are named at the beginning of the enumerated nidhi sequence?
premises: Padma is named as a treasure.
Mahāpadma, makara, and kacchapa are also named.
inference: The nidhi sequence begins with padma, mahāpadma, makara, and kacchapa.
uncertainties: Only four of the eight treasures are named in this verse.
plain_english: These include the padma, mahāpadma, makara, and kacchapa treasures, and so on.
